description: Auditor binding spec for the climate_emission_minimal per-dir spec-pinned migration. Binds the representative structured output (the per-vendor Scope-3 emission attribution list) to an in-dir recompute primitive and the generic structured comparator over the allowlisted climate_attribution_v1 schema (fields vendor_id/tier/activity_amount/activity_unit/emission_factor_kg_co2e_per_unit/factor_source/attributed_kg_co2e; extended by FIX-E from the original vendor_id/tier/attributed_kg_co2e so the checked claim binds the disclosure-relevant fields, not just the activity*factor product). Distinct from the central spec_id climate.emission.v1 (different id, different primitive_id, different comparator kind). Authority-pinned, not producer-asserted.
